verses.translation: By the sky full of constellations
and the promised Day ˹of Judgment˺
and the witness and what is witnessed
Condemned are the makers of the ditch—
the fire ˹pit˺, filled with fuel—
when they sat around it

verses.arabicText: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wahum ʿalā mā yafʿalūna bil-mu'minīna shuhūdun
verses.translation: watching what they had ˹ordered to be˺ done to the believers

verses.arabicText: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Wamā naqamū min'hum illā ay-yu'minū bil-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥamīd
verses.translation: who they resented for no reason other than belief in Allah—the Almighty, the Praiseworthy—

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: Alladhī lahu mul'ku s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdun
verses.translation: ˹the One˺ to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and earth. And Allah is a Witness over all things

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
verses.transliteration: Inna alladhīna fatanū l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti thumma lam yatūbū falahum ʿadhābu jahannama walahum ʿadhābu l-ḥarīq
verses.translation: Those who persecute the believing men and women and then do not repent will certainly suffer the punishment of Hell and the torment of burning

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.transliteration: Inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru dhālika l-fawzu l-kabīr
verses.translation: Surely those who believe and do good will have Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the greatest triumph
Indeed, the ˹crushing˺ grip of your Lord is severe
˹For˺ He is certainly the One Who originates and resurrects ˹all˺
And He is the All-Forgiving, All-Loving—
Lord of the Throne, the All-Glorious
Doer of whatever He wills
Has the story of the ˹destroyed˺ forces reached you ˹O Prophet˺—
˹the forces of˺ Pharaoh and Thamûd
Yet the disbelievers ˹still˺ persist in denial
But Allah encompasses them from all sides
In fact, this is a glorious Quran
˹recorded˺ in a Preserved Tablet
